headline: Hidalgo County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Hidalgo County face an elevated risk. In the past 8 years of records since 2018, a long outage of 12 hours or more happens about once every 10 years. In February 2021, 16% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 91 hours. In July 2020, 20% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 76 hours. One Core lasts about 15 hours in June. One Core lasts about 36 hours in February. Two Cores last about 26 hours in June. Two Cores cover 74% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours for a home with gas heat and a larger footprint. Base confirms sizing at install.
